Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/aspell-fuzz/ossfuzz.sh:
     1	#!/bin/bash -eu
     2	
     3	# This script is called by the oss-fuzz main project when compiling the fuzz
     4	# targets. This script is regression tested by travisoss.sh.
     5	
     6	# Save off the current folder as the build root.
     7	export BUILD_ROOT=$PWD
     8	export ASPELL_PREFIX=$OUT/deps
     9	export DICT_DIR=$OUT/dict
    10	
    11	if [[ ! -d ${DICT_DIR} ]]
    12	then
    13	    mkdir -p ${DICT_DIR}
    14	fi
    15	
    16	export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -g"
    17	export CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -g"
    18	
    19	echo "CC: $CC"
    20	echo "CXX: $CXX"
    21	echo "LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE: $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE"
    22	echo "CFLAGS: $CFLAGS"
    23	echo "CXXFLAGS: $CXXFLAGS"
    24	echo "OUT: $OUT"
    25	
    26	export MAKEFLAGS+="-j$(nproc)"
    27	
    28	# Install dependencies
    29	apt-get -y install \
    30	    automake \
    31	    autopoint \
    32	    bzip2 \
    33	    gettext \
    34	    libtool \
    35	    texinfo \
    36	    wget
    37	
    38	# Compile and install libaspell.
    39	pushd $SRC/aspell
    40	export LIBS="-lpthread"
    41	./autogen
    42	./configure \
    43	    --enable-static \
    44	    --disable-shared \
    45	    --disable-pspell-compatibility \
    46	    --prefix=$ASPELL_PREFIX \
    47	    --enable-pkgdatadir=$DICT_DIR \
    48	    --enable-pkglibdir=$DICT_DIR
    49	
    50	make V=1
    51	make install
    52	popd
    53	
    54	# Compile the fuzzer.
    55	autoreconf -i
    56	./configure --with-aspell=$ASPELL_PREFIX
    57	make V=1
    58	
    59	# Copy the fuzzer and corpus to the output directory.
    60	cp -v aspell_fuzzer $OUT/
    61	zip $OUT/aspell_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip aspell_fuzzer_corpus/*
    62	
    63	# Install some dictionaries!
    64	export PATH=$ASPELL_PREFIX/bin:$PATH
    65	
    66	install_language() {
    67	    LANG=$1
    68	    DICT=$2
    69	    pushd /tmp
    70	    wget -O- https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/aspell/dict/${LANG}/$DICT.tar.bz2 | tar xfj -
    71	    pushd $DICT
    72	    ./configure
    73	    make install
    74	    popd
    75	    popd
    76	}
    77	
    78	install_language en aspell6-en-2016.11.20-0
    79	install_language pt_BR aspell6-pt_BR-20131030-12-0
    80	
    81	# Verify that one corpus input runs.
    82	echo "Running a single corpus input"
    83	FUZZ_VERBOSE=yes $OUT/aspell_fuzzer aspell_fuzzer_corpus/en_us_input_utf8
    84
